text:
Lina Park: Quick mock + proposal for SLO inline help + burst labeling. Fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/slo-burst-proposal. TL;DR: add a compact inline help under the SLO slider that shows two micro-metrics (expected p95 latency, estimated cost delta) and replace the plain 'Burst' chip with a contextual badge that explains duration and when it's disabled. Sam Ortiz: Nice! Microcopy looks good at a glance. My worry: inline help could push other controls down on small widths. Can we make it collapsible or hover-activated? :thinking: Raj Patel: +1 for hover/popover. It must also be keyboard accessible — info icon should open on Enter/Space. Also we need aria-describedby for the slider so screen readers get the exact text. Mia Gomez: Accessibility nit: slider needs explicit labels for min/max and a live SLO readout. Suggest aria-valuetext on the thumb like: `aria-valuetext="SLO target 250ms, budget 60%"`. That gives useful context. Lina Park: Agreed. My implementation note: add an offscreen element with the explanatory copy and reference it from the slider: `aria-describedby="slo-help-1738502468"`. Example snippet in the mock: `
This slider sets the P95 latency SLO. Lower values increase cost.
` Sam Ortiz: Copy tweak: instead of single-word 'Burst' use `Burst capacity (short-term)` for the badge. Tooltip text: `Burst uses spare GPUs for up to X minutes and may trigger surge pricing.` Shorter line for mobile. Raj Patel: Edge case: pinned dedicated pools should show burst disabled with a clear reason. UI text idea: `Burst unavailable for pinned pools — burst only applies to elastic pools.` Also ensure the burst badge state is perceivable without color (icon + text). Lina Park: Design question: do we show numeric estimates (e.g., `~10 req/s (+12% cost)`) inline or only on hover? I think show it on hover to reduce noise but keep a small chevron that reveals the numbers. Mia Gomez: Keyboard flow suggestion: tab order = slider -> info icon -> burst toggle -> pool picker. Tooltip must be focusable and closable with Escape. Also ensure focus styles meet 3:1 contrast on the chevrons. :white_check_mark: Sam Ortiz: Visuals: thumb color states need stronger contrast. When SLO tighter than baseline, use darker green and a thicker focus ring. Also add a dashed outline for keyboard focus on the badge. design-bot: Mock uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/slo-burst-proposal?node-id=42:0. @Lina Park pinned the file. Lina Park: Next steps: I'll iterate the mock to include the offscreen description and the hover-to-reveal numbers, then tag @Mia for an a11y pass and @Raj for edge-case flows (pinned pools, dedicated). Thanks all — will push an updated artboard by EOD. :sparkles:
